controles.affirmation: Trois plaintes derivees distinctes d'actionnaires visant les dirigeants et administrateurs sont en cours (Silva, Mason, Wasserman)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q Q1 FY2027, Item 1 Legal Proceedings : 'On May 27, 2025, the United States District Court for the Western District of New York entered an order consolidating the Silva and Mason litigations and staying proceedings pending the entry of a final judgment in Meza. On August 8, 2025, the plaintiff in the Wasserman litigation filed a notice and proposed order voluntarily dismissing that litigation, which was so ordered by the United States District Court for the District of Delaware on August 14, 2025.'
controles.correction_proposee: Wasserman a ete volontairement abandonnee et l'abandon a ete homologue le 14 aout 2025 : elle n'est plus en cours. Silva et Mason ont ete consolidees en une seule procedure, SUSPENDUE dans l'attente d'un jugement definitif dans Meza. Formulation correcte : 'Deux plaintes derivees consolidees (Silva et Mason) sont suspendues dans l'attente de l'issue de Meza ; une troisieme (Wasserman) a ete abandonnee en aout 2025.'

controles.affirmation: La requete en irrecevabilite deposee par la societe a fait l'objet d'une audience le 22 juillet 2026 mais aucune decision n'a encore ete rendue
controles.verbatim_source: 'Defendants' motion to dismiss the amended complaint was fully briefed as of December 12, 2025, and oral argument on that motion has been scheduled to be held on July 22, 2026.'
controles.correction_proposee: Le document dit que l'audience est PROGRAMMEE pour le 22 juillet 2026. L'ATT est arretee au 1er juillet 2026 : elle ne peut pas affirmer que l'audience s'est tenue. Ecrire : 'une audience sur cette requete est programmee pour le 22 juillet 2026'.

controles.affirmation: Un recours collectif d'actionnaires (Meza) allegue des declarations trompeuses, d'abord sur les perspectives Vins et Spiritueux puis, dans sa version amendee, sur les perspectives Biere ; violations des sections 10(b) et 20(a)
controles.verbatim_source: 'asserts claims for alleged violations of Sections 10(b) and 20(a) of the Exchange Act and Rule 10b-5 ... concerning ... the Company's strategies intended to improve the performance of our wine and spirits business. On July 17, 2025, an amended complaint was filed ... but alleges materially false or misleading statements or omissions ... concerning ... the prospects of our beer business.'

controles.affirmation: Resume : 'Plusieurs plaintes d'actionnaires visant les communications de la direction sur ces deux activites sont en cours'
controles.verbatim_source: 'The amended complaint does not allege misstatements or omissions regarding our wine and spirits business.'
controles.correction_proposee: La plainte operante dans Meza ne vise plus que l'activite Biere ; les allegations sur les Vins et Spiritueux ont ete abandonnees dans la version amendee. Ne pas ecrire 'ces deux activites'.

controles.affirmation: 91% du CA vient du segment Biere et 98,5% des seuls Etats-Unis pour l'exercice clos le 28 fevrier 2026 (Beer 8,315 Mds $, W&S 0,824 Mds $, US 9,006 Mds $, hors US 0,133 Mds $)
Depreciation totale de survaleur Vins et Spiritueux de 2 740,7 M$ en FY2025, valeur comptable ramenee a zero, plus 57,0 M$ de depreciation de marques
controles.verbatim_source: 'a $2,740.7 million total goodwill impairment and the carrying value being written down to zero' ; '$57.0 million trademark impairment on certain then-existing held for sale wine brands' ; 'The carrying amount of our Wine and Spirits segment goodwill was zero as of May 31, 2026, February 28, 2026, and February 28, 2025'

controles.affirmation: Resultat operationnel du segment Vins et Spiritueux negatif au T1 FY2027 (-1,1 M$)
controles.verbatim_source: 'Comparable operating income (loss) 891.4 (1.1) (56.1) 834.2' (colonnes Beer / Wine and Spirits / Corporate)
controles.correction_proposee: Preciser qu'il s'agit du 'comparable operating income (loss)', la mesure de segment utilisee par le CODM.

controles.affirmation: Effectifs a environ 9 400 salaries, en baisse de 11% sur un an
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : 'As of February 28, 2026, we had approximately 9,400 employees, including approximately 1,100 employees through our equally-owned joint venture with Owens-Illinois' ; 10-K FY2025 : 'we had approximately 10,600 employees, including approximately 1,300 employees through our equally-owned joint venture'

controles.affirmation: Dette long terme 10 296,5 M$ au 28 fevrier 2026, juste valeur 9 858,2 M$ ; source citee 10-Q Q1 FY2027
controles.verbatim_source: 'As of May 31, 2026, the carrying amount of long-term debt, including the current portion, was $10,197.5 million, compared with an estimated fair value of $9,588.0 million. As of February 28, 2026, the carrying amount of long-term debt, including the current portion, was $10,296.5 million, compared with an estimated fair value of $9,858.2 million.'
controles.correction_proposee: Chiffre perime : le meme paragraphe du 10-Q donne la valeur au 31 mai 2026 (10 197,5 M$ / 9 588,0 M$), date de cloture du trimestre. Utiliser la donnee la plus recente.

controles.affirmation: Le contrat de credit 2025 impose un ratio de levier net maximal de 4,0x, sans que ce seuil soit atteint a ce jour
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : 'As of February 28, 2026, under our 2025 Credit Agreement, the minimum interest coverage ratio was 2.5x and the maximum net leverage ratio was 4.0x' ; 10-Q Q1 FY2027 : '[we were] in compliance with our covenants under our 2025 Credit Agreement and our indentures'
controles.correction_proposee: Le seuil chiffre de 4,0x figure dans le 10-K FY2026, pas dans le 10-Q Q1 FY2027 cite en preuve (qui mentionne seulement 'a maximum net leverage ratio'). Corriger la reference.

controles.affirmation: Rachats d'actions du trimestre en recul de 27% sur un an, a 223,8 M$
controles.verbatim_source: 'Purchases of treasury stock (223.8) (306.1) 82.3' (10-Q Q1 FY2027, tableau de financement)

13,0 M$ de tarifs Section 232 au T1 FY2027 ; en avril 2026 le gouvernement americain a retire la biere importee du champ des tarifs Section 232
controles.verbatim_source: '$13.0 million of tariffs, largely on aluminum imports under Section 232' ; 'In April 2026, the U.S. government removed beer made from malt, which includes our beer products, from the scope of the Section 232 aluminum and aluminum derivative tariffs that had been in place at various rates since February 2025.'

controles.affirmation: Declin du marche de gros americain du vin et consommateur contraint (inflation, essence, chomage)
controles.verbatim_source: 'ongoing economic uncertainty and other socioeconomic factors, including subdued spend, depressed sentiment, value-seeking behaviors, higher consumer prices and reductions in consumer discretionary income, including from increased gas prices, elevated unemployment, inflation, rising costs'
controles.correction_proposee: Le verbatim exact 'declines in the U.S. wholesale wine market' n'a pas ete retrouve dans le 10-Q Q1 FY2027 ; le reste de l'argument est bien soutenu par le passage ci-dessus.
